title: Grandfather's 80th birthday
description: William turns 80. The whole family gathered at the lake house for cake, stories, and a very off-key rendition of Happy Birthday.

title: Margaret's 65th birthday
description: A surprise party for Margaret's 65th, organized by Emily and Sarah. Her reaction made the whole family cry.

title: Summer reunion at the lake
description: The first full-family reunion in seven years. Shot on James's old camera, in the spirit of every summer before.
